info.name: BuiltWith Change Bulk Processing Domain Lookup API

params.name: KEY
params.description: Your BuiltWith API authentication key (UUID format)

params.name: LOOKUP
params.description: Domain or comma-separated list of up to 16 domains to look up. Use root domains only.

params.name: HIDETEXT
params.description: Set to 'yes' to exclude technology descriptions and links

params.name: NOMETA
params.description: Set to 'yes' to skip address and company metadata

params.name: NOPII
params.description: Set to 'yes' to remove personally identifiable information (names/emails)

params.name: LIVEONLY
params.description: Set to 'yes' to return only currently active technologies

params.name: TRUST
params.description: Set to 'yes' to include trust/safety data (uses additional API credits)

params.name: FDRANGE
params.description: Filter by detection date range in YYYY-MM-DD|YYYY-MM-DD format

params.name: NOATTR
params.description: Set to 'yes' to exclude technology attributes

params.name: CATEGORIES
params.description: Set to '1' to return technology category list instead of domain data

params.name: VERTICALS
params.description: Set to '1' to return vertical list instead of domain data

items.docs: Returns the technology stack and metadata for one or more domains in JSON format. Supports up to 16 domains as a comma-separated list.
